ambiguity.detail: Mention of a 'hearing' and past trysts adds deep lore that a cold viewer has to piece together.

verdict.hook_line: Absolution is free. Discretion has a price.
verdict.cliffhanger_line: Frantic backward tracking close-up on Agnes stumbling back into the shadows of the hallway, horrified by the lethal secret she has uncovered before an abrupt cut to black.
verdict.viewer_takeaway: A forbidden affair between a woman and a priest is accidentally discovered by an innocent bystander, threatening lethal consequences.
verdict.why_it_works: Transitioning from steamy romance dialogue straight into a classic 'caught in the act' thriller trope provides a massive payoff and cliffhanger.
